answer: Operator-Linked Settlement Revocation (OLSR): each agent wallet is bound to an operator enclave key; payouts clear after a delta delay. A challenge proving one operator key controls multiple wallets revokes that operator’s pending settlements and onboarding rights across tundra and karst deployments—wallet balances remain untouched. Attacker cost: one accountable legal operator plus independent hardware enclave per identity; sybil fleets collapse into orphaned capacity.
